en_title: Adam Driver Confirms His Role in Heat 2, Comments on Recent Michael Mann Shooting
cn_title: 亚当·德赖弗确认出演《盗火线2》，谈及迈克尔·曼近期枪击事故
opus_summary: 亚当·德赖弗确认将在《盗火线2》中饰演主要反派Otis Wardell，并表示期待再次与导演迈克尔·曼合作。他称影片拍摄延期原本就在计划内，曼近期在射击场发生的意外没有明显阻碍制作，自己将于12月初开始拍摄。

paragraphs.en: Adam Driver has confirmed his role in Heat 2, and commented on director Michael Mann's recent shooting accident.
paragraphs.cn: 亚当·德赖弗确认出演《盗火线2》，并谈及导演迈克尔·曼近期遭遇的枪击事故。

paragraphs.en: Appearing on an episode of The Rich Eisen Show , Driver confirmed to the host that he will be playing the role of Otis Wardell in Mann's upcoming follow-up to the 1995 crime film. With a story spanning multiple time periods, Heat 2 serves as both a prequel and a sequel to the original film, and Driver's Wardell character is its principal antagonist. In letting confirmation of his role slip, Driver joked, "I think I can say that, but I'll find out pretty soon [if I can't]."
paragraphs.cn: 德赖弗在参加一期《The Rich Eisen Show》时向主持人确认，他将在曼执导的这部1995年犯罪电影的后续作品中饰演Otis Wardell。《盗火线2》的故事跨越多个时期，既是原片的前传，也是续集，而德赖弗饰演的Wardell是片中的主要反派。德赖弗无意中确认自己的角色时开玩笑说：「我想我可以说这件事，不过我很快就会知道［我能不能说］了。」

paragraphs.en: Driver also expressed enthusiasm at being reunited with Mann, who he previously teamed up with on the 2023 motor racing biopic, Ferrari.
paragraphs.cn: 德赖弗还对与曼再次合作表示期待，两人此前曾在2023年赛车传记电影《法拉利》中合作。

paragraphs.en: "Heat is a masterpiece," Driver told Eisen. "I love Michael, I loved working with him [on] Ferrari, but working on this? I'm excited. The cast is so awesome."
paragraphs.cn: 「《盗火线》是一部杰作，」德赖弗告诉Eisen，「我喜欢迈克尔，我很喜欢和他合作［拍摄］《法拉利》，但参与这部作品？我很兴奋。演员阵容太棒了。」

paragraphs.en: Driver also mentioned that Heat 2's shooting schedule had been delayed, and that he wouldn't start on the production until early December. When asked by Eisen if the delay had been caused by Mann's recent shooting accident at a Los Angeles gun range , Driver insisted that Mann's misfortune hadn't significantly halted production.
paragraphs.cn: 德赖弗还提到，《盗火线2》的拍摄日程推迟了，他要到12月初才会开始参与制作。当Eisen问到推迟是否由曼近期在洛杉矶一家射击场发生的枪击事故造成时，德赖弗坚称，曼遭遇的不幸并未导致制作大幅停滞。

paragraphs.en: "No, [the delay] was already part of the plan," said Driver. "[Mann] is good. I texted him, he immediately responded, [and] he was at work the next day."
paragraphs.cn: 「没有，［推迟］本来就在计划之中，」德赖弗说，「［曼］很好。我给他发了短信，他立刻回复了，［而且］他第二天就去工作了。」

paragraphs.en: Heat 2's well, heat , has been rising steadily since February of this year, when The Dark Knight star Christian Bale confirmed that he was about to start filming the movie in Chicago. Then in July, Inception's Leonardo DiCaprio came on board, confirming that he would be playing the role of Chris Shiherlis (originally played by Val Kilmer), and that Bale would be tackling the Vincent Hanna part (originally played by Al Pacino). The Bear's Ebon Moss-Bachrach was apparently in final talks for a role in the film in September , although confirmation of his casting has yet to be officially announced.
paragraphs.cn: 《盗火线2》的热度自今年2月以来持续攀升，当时《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》主演克里斯蒂安·贝尔确认，他即将在芝加哥开始拍摄这部电影。随后在7月，《盗梦空间》的莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥加盟，确认他将饰演Chris Shiherlis（最初由方·基默饰演），而贝尔将出演Vincent Hanna（最初由阿尔·帕西诺饰演）。《熊家餐馆》的艾邦·摩斯-巴克拉赫显然在9月就出演片中一个角色进行最后洽谈，但官方尚未宣布确认他参演。

paragraphs.en: In the 2022 Heat 2 novel that the film is based on, Driver's wardell character is described as being the psychopathic leader of an ultraviolent gang of home invaders. Although the book's story is presented in a non-linear structure that hops around between 1988, mid-nineties, and all the way up to the year 2000, Driver said, "As a script it's even more condensed and streamlined. Obviously in the book you have to have a lot of descriptors, but with the film it's just a missile."
paragraphs.cn: 在这部电影改编自的2022年小说《盗火线2》中，德赖弗饰演的Wardell被描述为一个极端暴力的入室抢劫团伙的精神变态头目。尽管书中的故事以非线性结构呈现，在1988年、90年代中期以及一直到2000年的时间点之间跳转，德赖弗说：「作为剧本，它更加精简、紧凑。显然，书里必须有大量描述，但电影就像一枚导弹。」

paragraphs.en: While the original Heat was made with Warner Bros., Heat 2 has since ended up at Amazon MGM Studios .
paragraphs.cn: 虽然原版《盗火线》是与华纳兄弟合作制作的，但《盗火线2》后来落到了Amazon MGM Studios手中。
